versions.changelog: Update display name to Native Typeform

Initial release. Access Typeform forms, responses, and stats via the official API.

- List, search, and fetch forms using the Typeform API.
- Retrieve form definitions, responses, and filter responses by date or limit.
- Get form insights (views, completions, rates) and account details.
- Requires a Typeform personal access token for authentication.
- No third-party proxies; all requests go directly to api.typeform.com.
